BrochureContent.Content:
Bowe property presents to the market 28 Rosewood Rise, Bandon as a truly beautiful and very impressive three bedroom home within this mature and sought after residential location less then 2km from Bandon town and 29kms southwest of Cork City. With flawless accommodation presented over two floors consisting of three bedrooms, master ensuite, family bathroom, guest w.c. together with a front lounge & a beautiful open plan fully fitted kitchen/dining/living area with large glazed double doors going out onto enormous gardens with beautiful patios, lawn areas and flawlessly landscaped with a wonderful, natural sunny orientation and absolute privacy. The property has a host of features incorporating premium appliances, gas fired central heating, ceramic tiling, wooden floors, large storage attic and linin closet/airing cupboard. The property has been fastidiously maintained by it’s original owner and is now offered for sale as a beautiful home on the eastern fringes of Bandon Town within close driving distance of the coastline, Innishannon and Cork City with excellent public transport links from Bandon Town which is a thriving and expanding market town with a very exciting choice of social and public amenities from parks, playgrounds, schools, shops, cafes, public library and much more.

Viewing comes highly recommended and is strictly by prior appointment.
